38. BENJAMIN YALE (44), was indicted for feloniously killing and slaying Eliza Garritt; he was also charged on the Coroner's Inquisition with the wilful murder of the said Eliza Garritt.

MR. RIBTON conducted the Prosecution.

NOT GUILTY .

The particulars of this and the following case were not of a nature for publication.
